subject: Post-demo: next steps — cost owners and approval motion
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novatek.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo: next steps — cost owners and approval motion

Hi Marta — thanks for taking the demo today. Quick recap from our side and the asks we left with: 

- Monthly token profile you mentioned: 8–14M tokens/mth (peaks in product experiments), canonical steady-state estimate ~10M.
- Pricing target we discussed: aiming for a unit around $800–$950 per 1M tokens depending on commitment/term.

Can you confirm the following so we can put together a clean commercial motion this week?
1) Economic buyer / final approver (name + email) — we need the person who signs the contract or signs budgets.
2) Finance/procurement contact for PO and payment terms (email + required billing info).
3) Budget owner & rough budget range for this initiative (annualized if possible).
4) Procurement timeline: PO/contract needed by when to hit your Q4 pilots?

I've attached a short estimate (redwood-pricing-1M-estimate.xlsx) and a one-page mutual action plan to propose next steps. If you prefer, we can propose a single condensed commercial package (6-month committed tokens + extended support) that maps to the $/1M figure.

Goal: confirm buyer + finance this week so we can lock a draft SOW and pricing. Proposed next step: 30-min alignment with Luca (buying sponsor) + procurement to agree PO path. Available times Tue/Wed morning EST.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-pricing-1M-estimate.xlsx (preview)
Attachment: mutual-action-plan-Novatek.pdf

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novatek.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@novatek.com>, procurement_apac@novatek.com
Date: Mon, 19 Oct 2026 11:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-demo: next steps — cost owners and approval motion

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap and for the materials. A few answers from our side: 

- Economic buyer / final approver: Luca Bianchi, Head of Platform (luca.bianchi@novatek.com) — he'll sign off on platform spend over $50k ARR.
- Finance/procurement: procurement_apac@novatek.com (they manage POs for product infra).
- Budget owner: Product Platform (reports to Luca) — current FY23 allocation for LLM infra is €70k–€110k, but Luca is open to reprioritizing if we can show unit economics.
- Procurement timeline: ideally PO in place by 2026-11-15 for pilot start in early Dec. Net-30 standard.

Two asks from procurement security & legal: 1) standard contract template attached (novatek-contract-template.docx) and 2) SOC 2 report / security checklist for our InfoSec review. Can you send a short SOC 2 summary + CISO contact?

I'll loop Luca on next steps — happy to set a 30-min slot Tue 14:00 CET if that works for Redwood.

Cheers,
Marta
Head of Data Products | Novatek
marta.ruiz@novatek.com
Attachment: novatek-contract-template.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@novatek.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novatek.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>, procurement_apac@novatek.com
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo: next steps — cost owners and approval motion

Luca / Marta — thanks for the quick responses and the contract template, Marta. Sergio (cc'd) is our solutions lead and will help map the 10M token profile to two commercial options:

Option A — 6-month committed (10M tokens/mo average): $850 / 1M tokens effective (preferred for predictability). Estimated monthly invoice: $8,500.
Option B — Pay-as-you-go with volume discounts: starts at $950 / 1M tokens, step-downs at 15M+ /mo.

If Novatek can commit to the 6-month option we can stretch discounts and include a short performance SLA and one onboarding workshop. That would map to a mid-year spend in the €70k–€110k range depending on term.

Sergio: can you prepare a simple line-item estimate (I'll attach the updated xlsx) and a short security one-pager for Marta's procurement team?

Luca / Marta, would Tue 20 Oct 14:00 CET work for a 30-min sync with procurement to confirm PO path and sign-off owner? If yes, we'll send a calendar invite and attach the commercial summary + SOC2 summary ahead of the call.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-pricing-1M-estimate.xlsx (v2)

From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novatek.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@novatek.com>, procurement_apac@novatek.com
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:44:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Post-demo: next steps — cost owners and approval motion

Marissa / Sergio — that time works for us, thanks. Please go ahead and: 

- Send the 1-page commercial summary and the updated estimate before the call (we'll share with procurement).
- Include the SOC 2 summary & the CISO contact. Our procurement will want the SOC 2 summary plus a short runbook for data retention and deletion.

To confirm: economic buyer is Luca; procurement contact is procurement_apac@novatek.com; budget owner is Product Platform (Luca's org) with the FY allocation noted above. If you can provide a draft SOW and sample invoice (net-30 terms), that will speed approval.

I'll expect the invite for Tue 14:00 CET (20 Oct) and the docs.

Best,
Marta
Head of Data Products | Novatek
Attachment: internal-procurement-questions.pdf
